decisions.reason: Fixing the password-dependent field mechanism does not change the independent requirement that interactive fields retain help labels.
The source decision addresses the suitability of password-dependent legacy controls, not the required behavior for clearing placeholder text when a field is activated.
Table stability during legacy copy-paste is independent of the decision to fix password-dependent editable fields.
The shared term legacy refers to different concerns; fixing legacy form-field controls does not change the required legacy-document copy-paste workflow.
Reliable line breaks after pasted content are unaffected by the editable-field control fix.
Bullet appearance has no necessary semantic dependency on the editable-field mechanism.
The request to fix legacy editable fields does not add, remove, or alter any required Word style entries.
Tab-controlled list hierarchy remains valid unchanged and is unrelated to password-dependent form controls.
The product-level field fix does not change the previously requested assessment process, outputs, or time budget.
Required template theme colors are unaffected by the decision to fix the editable-field controls.
Typography and style-spacing requirements do not change as a necessary consequence of fixing password-dependent fields.
